A colour theme you can live with.

A familiar blue, a little warm amber, or something quieter in violet. Solai brings the same colour language to the tools you use every day, with clear text, thoughtful contrast, and enough personality to feel like yours.

Compare the shapes of a, g, r and t, the punctuation, and how each line wraps. You can click the heading or paragraph and type your own text; your edits stay here while you switch.
